column6: Miller Center speaker series lists Brian Murphy for 2026-09-15; Spring Art Competition 2026 is also on the SUU calendar.

City Economic Development Director Chad Thomas is listed as a speaker at the 2026 RISE Business Summit on 2026-09-10.
